content: Our corpus is built at stock code level by collecting headlines from the Reuters Archive. This archive groups the headlines by date, starting from 1 January 2007. Each headline is a html link (<a href> tag) to the full body of the news, where the anchor text is the headline content followed by the release time. For example, the page dated 16 Dec 2016 has the headline “Procter & Gamble appoints Nelson Peltz to board 5:26PM UTC”.
